In this era our record converges on a single week. On 2024-04-20, thirty-nine of us said "around the world," thirty-four said "humanitarian aid to," and thirty-one said "ukraine israel and" on the same day. The legislative name spread with us: twenty-seven said "security supplemental appropriations" and "israel security supplemental," twenty-six said "security supplemental appropriations act," and twenty-five carried the full "israel security supplemental appropriations act." Twenty-three of us said "civilians in gaza."

Bradley Scott Schneider first said the supplemental phrases, on 2023-11-01. Peter Welch first said "around the world," Kirsten E. Gillibrand first said "humanitarian aid to," Mark Pocan first said "ukraine israel and," John Garamendi first said "civilians in gaza." We adopted them later, together, on one day. We report this as it stands in the record.
